newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures fall on speculative selling.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures fall on speculative selling.

text.p: Castorseeed September delivery opened 15 rupees lower at 1,148 rupees per quintal (100 kg) on Monday on heavy speculative selling, dealers said.
They the market was subdued due to the shifting of some 15,000 tonnes of castorseed June contract to September at a contango (forward) charge of 78 rupees per quintal.

Castorseed ready was down five rupees at 1,088 rupees per quintal on improved arrivals in India's western state of Gujarat, the country's main castorseed supplier. Castor oil fell one rupee to 248 rupees per 10 kg on poor export demand.
In edible oils, groundnut oil fell two rupees to 360 rupees per 10 kg on continued summer arrivals of groundnut in Gujarat.
Imported palmolein was quoted two rupees lower at 266 rupees per 10 kg on continued arrival of supplies. Imported sunflower oil fell one rupee to 255 rupees per 10 kg.
